name: Plaque
author: E. T. Carter
description: An engraved brass plaque fills the frame, brushed metal with a chamfered rim, a hairline border rule and a slotted screw in each corner. In the left third a ring emblem is cut into the plate as real V-grooves, one wall lit and the other in shadow with a dark oxidised fill in the bottom of every cut, and to its right a long flat-bottomed recess sits empty and even as a satin band for a wordmark. A point key light sweeps slowly left and right, dragging a tall anisotropic sheen across the brushing and flipping the lit walls of the engraving as it passes.

params.label: Sweep speed
params.effect: How fast the key light travels across the plate; 0 parks it and the sheen holds still.

params.label: Brush grain
params.effect: Depth of the brushing scratches; 0 is a mirror-smooth plate, high is coarse belt-sanded metal that shreds the sheen.

params.label: Engrave depth
params.effect: How deep the emblem, border and band are cut; shallow reads as a light etch, deep throws hard wall shadows.

params.label: Emblem size
params.effect: Radius of the ring emblem as a fraction of frame height; the wordmark band shortens to make room as it grows.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: Tightness of the anisotropic sheen; low is a broad satin glow, high a narrow hard streak of light.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer pulls the key light across the plate; 0 ignores the mouse.
